passive-voice.title: be + past participle
passive-voice.rule: When something is done to a thing, use be / been + the -ed form of the verb: should be allowed, has been removed, will be restricted.
passive-voice.rule_zh: 被动语态：be / been + 过去分词，例如 should be allowed、has been removed。

examples.right: All the tests have been run.

perfect-tense.title: have + past participle
perfect-tense.rule: After has / have / had, use the past participle: I have started, it has changed, we have fixed it.
perfect-tense.rule_zh: has / have / had 后面接过去分词：have started、has changed。

examples.wrong: The build has fail twice today.
examples.right: The build has failed twice today.

past-tense.title: Past actions take the past tense
past-tense.rule: For something that already happened, use the past form: I changed it just now, I committed the wrong files yesterday.
past-tense.rule_zh: 已经发生的事用过去式：I changed、I committed。

examples.wrong: Yesterday I fix the login bug.
examples.right: Yesterday I fixed the login bug.

missing-be.title: Don't drop am / is / are
missing-be.rule: An English sentence needs a verb. Before an adjective, a place or a noun phrase, add am / is / are: I'm not satisfied, the venue is hard to see, this is not good.
missing-be.rule_zh: 形容词、名词前要有 am / is / are（中文常省略“是”，英文不能省）。

do-support.title: do / does / did for negatives and questions
do-support.rule: Make negatives with don't / doesn't / didn't + verb (they don't need it), and questions with do / does / did before the subject (why did you say that?).
do-support.rule_zh: 否定句和疑问句要用 do / does / did：They don't need…、Why did you say…?

subject-verb.title: he / she / it / this takes -s
subject-verb.rule: With one thing (he, she, it, this, the flow, the agent), the verb takes -s and be becomes is: this agent has, the flow is, it works.
subject-verb.rule_zh: 第三人称单数：动词加 -s，be 用 is：this agent has、the flow is。

verb-patterns.title: want to do, help someone do
verb-patterns.rule: Some verbs need 'to' before the next verb (want to change, need to check), others take the verb directly (let users see, help me fix).
verb-patterns.rule_zh: 动词搭配：want / need 后加 to + 动词；let / help 后直接接动词。

examples.wrong: Please help me to fixing it.
I want try the new version.
examples.right: I want to try the new version.

question-order.title: Question word order
question-order.rule: In a direct question, put the helper verb before the subject: Is the result the same? Inside a longer sentence, use whether / if and normal order: Check whether the result is the same.
question-order.rule_zh: 直接疑问句助动词放主语前；句中的问题用 whether / if + 陈述语序。

examples.wrong: Can you tell me where is the config?
examples.right: Can you tell me where the config is?

missing-subject.title: Say who or what
missing-subject.rule: English sentences usually need a subject and often an object. Add it, this, I or you even when the meaning seems clear: It should be allowed. Don't run it for me.
missing-subject.rule_zh: 英文一般不能省略主语或宾语（it、this、I、you）。

examples.wrong: Is not working after the update.
examples.right: It isn't working after the update.
We should check the logs first.

run-on.title: One idea per sentence
run-on.rule: When you have two complete thoughts, end the first sentence with a full stop, or join them with and / but / so / because.
run-on.rule_zh: 两个完整的意思要用句号分开，或用 and / but / so / because 连接。

examples.wrong: The page loads slowly the images are too big.
examples.right: The page loads slowly. The images are too big.

plural-nouns.title: Plurals
plural-nouns.rule: Use -s for more than one: all features, these tables, five templates. Some nouns never take -s: information, feedback, equipment, code.
plural-nouns.rule_zh: 可数名词复数加 -s；information、feedback、equipment、code 不可数。

articles.title: a / an / the
articles.rule: Use a / an for one thing you haven't mentioned yet (a commit message), the for a specific thing you both know (the staged changes). Use an before a vowel sound (an issue).
articles.rule_zh: a / an 表示“一个”，the 表示特指；元音音素前用 an。

examples.wrong: Please write unit test for this.
examples.right: Please write a unit test for this.

word-form.title: Noun, verb or adjective?
word-form.rule: Many words change form by job: restrict (verb), restriction (noun), restricted (adjective); respond (verb), response (noun); specific (adjective), specifically (adverb).
word-form.rule_zh: 注意词性：restrict / restriction / restricted，respond / response。

examples.wrong: What is the different between them?
examples.right: What is the difference between them?

word-choice.title: The word English uses
word-choice.rule: Some words are close in meaning but not what English speakers say: 'have' (not 'got') for owning, 'looks hard' (not 'looks like hard'), 'by mistake' (not 'wrongly').
word-choice.rule_zh: 选词：意思接近，但英文习惯用另一个词。

examples.wrong: Can you borrow me your charger?
examples.right: Can you lend me your charger?

examples.wrong: I will revert to you tomorrow.
examples.right: I will get back to you tomorrow.

prepositions.title: in / on / at / to / for
prepositions.rule: Prepositions follow fixed pairs: a table of agents, in the table, refer to the docs, the same as, focus on.
prepositions.rule_zh: 介词有固定搭配：a table of、refer to、the same as。

no-need.title: 'No need' in a full sentence
no-need.rule: 'No need' alone is fine as a short reply. Inside a sentence say 'there's no need to…', 'you don't need to…' or 'it doesn't need…'.
no-need.rule_zh: 句子里用 there's no need to… 或 you don't need to…。

examples.right: There's no need to restart the server.

spelling.title: Spelling
spelling.rule: Slow down on words you type often. Your common slips: explan → explain, statisfied → satisfied, enought → enough, espacially → especially.
spelling.rule_zh: 常打错的单词，打字时放慢一点。

apostrophes.title: don't, I'm, it's
apostrophes.rule: Short forms need an apostrophe: don't, can't, I'm, it's, doesn't. Without it, 'dont' and 'im' look careless in work writing.

capitals.title: Capital letters
capitals.rule: Write I as a capital, start each sentence with a capital, and write names as their owners do: WhatsApp, GitHub, ClickHouse.
capitals.rule_zh: I 大写，句首大写，专有名词按官方写法（WhatsApp）。

singlish-particles.title: Leave out eh, ba, lah, meh, ah
singlish-particles.rule: Particles like eh, ba, lah, meh and ah are friendly with friends but sound unprofessional at work. Use please, let's, or a question tag like 'right?' instead.
singlish-particles.rule_zh: 工作写作中避免 eh、ba、lah、meh、ah 等语气词。

polite-requests.title: Polite requests
polite-requests.rule: With people, soften a request: Could you…, Can you help me…, Please…. A bare command is fine for a tool but can sound rude to a colleague.
polite-requests.rule_zh: 对同事提请求用 Could you… / Please…，语气更礼貌。

examples.right: Could you send me the report?

clear-feedback.title: Say what's wrong and why
clear-feedback.rule: When something is wrong, say what you expected, what you got, and why it matters. 'This is not correct' alone makes the reader guess.
clear-feedback.rule_zh: 指出问题时说明：期望什么、实际是什么、为什么重要。

examples.right: This is wrong: the total should include tax, but it doesn't.

word-order.title: Natural word order
word-order.rule: Put words in the order English uses. A verb like 'explain' takes its object directly, and 'in detail' comes after the object: explain the changes in detail.
word-order.rule_zh: 英语语序固定：explain 直接接宾语，in detail 放后面。

examples.wrong: I only can come on Friday.
examples.right: I can only come on Friday.
